answer: Require every identity to lock collateral in a vault with a long unbonding delay. Each epoch, the network emits a randomized pulse challenge that every identity must answer with fresh computational work inside a short window, work that cannot be precomputed or outsourced cheaply. Rewards then arrive like a tide, split evenly among all identities that answered the pulse. An attacker spawning N fake identities must lock N stakes and spend N times the per-epoch work, so the cost of faking scales linearly with the attack size while an honest participant pays the cost only once.
